I have worked for several years on backend and internal tool projects, mostly
around order management, inventory visibility, and data cleanup workflows. My
daily work included Java service development, Redis cache design, Python scripts
for migration checks, and React pages for operations teams. One long project
required untangling legacy data ownership, improving failed-task retries, and
making dashboards easier for support engineers to read during incidents.

In another role I helped the team move batch reports from manual spreadsheet
work into scheduled jobs. The work was not organized as a formal project list

of communication with product managers and support leads.
